Class PositionMovement

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.common.persistence.BasePositionMovement
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.position.PositionMovement
@Entity public class PositionMovement extends BasePositionMovement
Represents an entry in the position movements ledger (trading.position_movements). An immutable audit record capturing changes to account holdings.

    • PositionMovement

      public PositionMovement(UUID accountId, UUID instrumentId, UUID orderId, UUID executionId, String movementType, long quantityDelta, BigDecimal costDelta, OffsetDateTime createdAt)
      Constructs a new PositionMovement instance with the specified details.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the ID of the account associated with this position movement
      instrumentId - the ID of the instrument associated with this position movement
      orderId - the ID of the order that triggered this position movement, if applicable
      executionId - the ID of the execution that triggered this position movement, if applicable
      movementType - the type of movement (e.g., "BUY", "SELL")
      quantityDelta - the change in quantity for this position movement
      costDelta - the change in cost for this position movement
      createdAt - the timestamp when this position movement was created
